standard-dialogue-if-xilo-and-fabia-have.npc: I can't believe she's done this.
Fabia! She asked me to meet her, and I quote, 'by the special tree'. You may notice that she isn't here! I've been waiting for hours!

standard-dialogue-if-xilo-and-fabia-have.player: Do you think she might just be delayed?

standard-dialogue-if-xilo-and-fabia-have.npc: I know her too well. She wouldn't be delayed coming to see me.

standard-dialogue-if-xilo-and-fabia-have.player: Could you be at the wrong special tree?

standard-dialogue-if-xilo-and-fabia-have.npc: No! This is the one, singular, special tree!

standard-dialogue-if-xilo-and-fabia-have.text: If the player has not already talked to Fabia:

steps.player: Humour me for just a moment. What if, amongst this entire rainforest, there's a second very similar tree?

steps.npc: And Fabia would find herself at the wrong tree in this scenario?

steps.player: Or maybe it's you who is at the wrong one?

steps.npc: No, absolutely not! I know where to meet Fabia and I wouldn't miss any opportunity to do so!
This was the tree where we first met. It was a lovely day! A botanical tour of the rainforest, but the only thing I found myself looking at was her...

steps.player: Well, I'm sure the two of you will find each other soon. However, I do suspect that might happen sooner if you considered looking by some other trees...

steps.npc: Hmm... I'll think about it, but for now, I'll wait here a while longer.

standard-dialogue-if-xilo-and-fabia-have.text: If the player has already talked to Fabia:

steps.player: Hang on... I think I might have met this Fabia.
South of here, by some magic trees.

steps.npc: The magic trees? Of course! How could I have been so stupid! Thank you, iknami. I'll head over right away!

standard-dialogue-if-xilo-and-fabia-have.npc: Hello again, iknami! Thank you for helping us find each other!

standard-dialogue-if-xilo-and-fabia-have.speaker: Fabia
standard-dialogue-if-xilo-and-fabia-have.text: To think we were waiting by different trees! It was so silly of us!

standard-dialogue-if-xilo-and-fabia-have.player: Well, I'm happy to see you together again. Now, I'm sure you have a lot of catching up to do. I'll leave you to it.
